scripts.title: Larp Engine
scripts.features:
─ AIM ─
  Aimbot:
    • Enabled (lock keybind)
    • Draw FOV (color picker)
    • FOV Size (slider)
    • Dynamic FOV
    • Target NPC
    • Smooth (smoothness slider)
    • Target Bones (multi-select: head, arms, torso, legs)

  Silent Aim:
    • Enabled (keybind)
    • Draw FOV (color picker)
    • FOV Size (slider)
    • Dynamic FOV
    • Target NPC
    • Target Bones (multi-select)
    • Target Line (color picker)
    • Magic Bullet

─ VISUAL ─
  Players:
    • Box ESP (color, style: cornered/full)
    • Health Bar
    • Shield Bar
    • Holster
    • Username

  NPCs:
    • Box ESP (color, style: cornered/full)
    • Health Bar
    • Shield Bar
    • Holster
    • Username

  Lootable:
    • Corpse ESP (nametag, distance, tracer - all with color pickers)
    • Dropped Items (name, distance, tracer, box style, item filter)

  World:
    • Fullbright

─ MISC ─
  Weapons:
    • No Recoil
    • No Spread
    • No Camera Bob
    • No Sway
    • Instant Bullet
    • Instant ADS
    • Fire Rate Changer (slider)
    • Bullet Tracers (lifetime, texture dropdown, color)
    • Hit Sound (dropdown: Neverlose, Anime, etc.)
    • Reload Indicator

  Player:
    • Infinite Stamina
    • Infinite Shield
    • FOV Changer (slider)
    • Omni Sprint
    • Hide Body
    • Change Arms (material toggle, material dropdown, color)
    • Change Weapon (material toggle, material dropdown, color)
